```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

Read in data
```{r}
HBR_StrChem <- read.csv(here("Data","HBR_StrChem_1963-2025.csv")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))
#glimpse(HBR_StrChem)

HBR_StrDis <- read.csv(here("Data","HBR_StrDis_1956-2024.csv")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(DATE)) %>% select(-DATE)
#glimpse(HBR_StrDis)

HBR_PrecChem <- read.csv(here("Data","HBR_PrecChem_1963-2025.csv")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))
#glimpse(HBR_PrecChem)

HBR_PrecVol <- read.csv(here("Data","HBR_PrecVol_1956-2026.csv")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(DATE)) %>% select(-DATE)
#glimpse(HBR_PrecVol)

KNZ_StrDis1 <- read.csv(here("Data","KNZ_StrDis_01.csv")) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"))
KNZ_StrDis2 <- read.csv(here("Data","KNZ_StrDis_02-2_year.csv"), na.strings = ".") %>%
  mutate(date = make_date(RECYEAR, RECMONTH, RECDAY)) %>%
  filter_out(is.na(VOLUME))
KNZ_StrDis3 <- read.csv(here("Data","KNZ_StrDis_03-2_year.csv"), na.strings = ".") %>%
  mutate(date = make_date(RECYEAR, RECMONTH, RECDAY)) %>%
  filter_out(is.na(VOLUME))
KNZ_StrDis4 <- read.csv(here("Data","KNZ_StrDis_04-2_year.csv"), na.strings = ".") %>%
  mutate(date = make_date(RECYEAR, RECMONTH, RECDAY)) %>%
  filter_out(is.na(VOLUME))
KNZ_StrDis5 <- read.csv(here("Data","KNZ_StrDis_05-2_year.csv"), na.strings = ".") %>%
  mutate(date = make_date(RECYEAR, RECMONTH, RECDAY)) %>%
  filter_out(is.na(VOLUME))

KNZ_StrDis2b <- read.csv(here("Data","KNZ_StrDis_02-1_year.csv"))
KNZ_StrDis3b <- read.csv(here("Data","KNZ_StrDis_03-1_year.csv"))
KNZ_StrDis4b <- read.csv(here("Data","KNZ_StrDis_04-1_year.csv"))
KNZ_StrDis5b <- read.csv(here("Data","KNZ_StrDis_05-1_year.csv"))

KNZ_StrChem <- read.csv(here("Data","KNZ_StrChem_year.csv")) %>%
  mutate(date = make_date(RecYear, RecMonth, RecDay))

KNZ_Precip_HDQ <- read.csv(here("Data","KNZ_PrecVol_PrecChem_01_year.csv")) %>%
  mutate(dateon = as.Date(dateon, format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
         dateoff = as.Date(dateoff, format = "%m/%d/%Y"))
KNZ_Precip_all <- read.csv(here("Data","KNZ_PrecVol_PrecChem_02_year.csv")) %>%
  mutate(date = make_date(RecYear, RecMonth, RecDay),
         Watershed = Watershed %>% replace_values("n01b" ~ "N01B", 
                                                  "r20b" ~ "R20B", 
                                                  "020b" ~ "020B", 
                                                  c("00HQ", "00hq") ~ "hq"))

```

Summarize HBR
```{r}
HBR_StrChem_summary <- HBR_StrChem %>%
  select(site, date, NO3, NH4, TDN, DON) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(NO3, NH4, TDN, DON), names_to = "analyte", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter_out(is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(site, analyte) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), start = min(date), end = max(date))

HBR_PrecChem_summary <- HBR_PrecChem %>%
  select(site, date, precipCatch, NO3, NH4, TDN, DON) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(precipCatch, NO3, NH4, TDN, DON), names_to = "analyte", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter_out(is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(site, analyte) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), start = min(date), end = max(date))

HBR_PrecVol_summary <- HBR_PrecVol %>%
  filter_out(is.na(Precip)) %>%
  group_by(rainGage) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), start = min(date), end = max(date))

HBR_StrDis_summary <- HBR_StrDis %>%
  filter_out(is.na(Streamflow)) %>%
  group_by(WS) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), start = min(date), end = max(date))
```

Summarize KNZ
```{r}
KNZ_Prec_summary <- KNZ_Precip_all %>%
  group_by(Watershed) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), start = min(date, na.rm = T), end = max(date, na.rm = T))
```
